rules.title: Legacy/discontinued controller condition
rules.description: The installed processor is in a discontinued or end-of-life lifecycle state. Replacement, spares and support availability must be confirmed against current OEM lifecycle data before commitment.

rules.title: Lifecycle risk in transitional migration strategy
rules.description: A transitional strategy that retains 1746 I/O keeps discontinued hardware in the final architecture. Lifecycle exposure does not end at cutover and must be disclosed before a strategy is chosen.

rules.title: 1747-SDN incompatible with preserved-I/O strategy
rules.description: The 1747-SDN DeviceNet scanner has no supported operation behind a preserved-1746-I/O adapter strategy and no direct Compact 5000 equivalent. DeviceNet connectivity must be redesigned, not carried over.

rules.title: Incomplete DeviceNet topology/configuration
rules.description: No DeviceNet configuration backup and no node address list were supplied. Node count, addressing, baud rate, connection sizes and I/O assemblies cannot be established from the available evidence.

evidence.locator: no DeviceNet configuration artifact in manifest

unknown.missing_information: DeviceNet node addresses, baud rate and per-node configuration
unknown.commercial_impact: Node-level migration effort cannot be quantified
unknown.technical_impact: Replacement network design and I/O assembly mapping cannot be completed
unknown.recommended_resolution: Obtain a DeviceNet configuration backup (RSNetWorx) or perform an onsite network survey

rules.title: IB16 mapping conditional
rules.description: A Compact 5000 equivalent exists on paper. OEM mapping is a catalog correspondence, not a guarantee of field compatibility: input device type, leakage current, sinking/sourcing arrangement and existing field wiring must be verified.

rules.title: OB16 mapping conditional
rules.description: Output mapping is conditional on load type, inrush, per-point and per-module current limits, and on the existing field wiring arrangement.

rules.title: NI4 mapping conditional
rules.description: Analog input replacement changes raw data scaling and resolution. Every scaling calculation in the program that consumes these channels must be revisited; the replacement module is not a drop-in numerically.

rules.title: NO4I mapping conditional
rules.description: Isolated analog output replacement changes scaling, resolution and isolation topology. Output scaling logic and field isolation requirements must be verified.

rules.title: OW16 relay mapping conditional
rules.description: Relay output replacement is conditional on contact rating, load type and expected switching duty.

rules.title: PID instances require review
rules.description: SLC PID and Logix PIDE differ in gain form, tuning-constant units, scaling and update-time handling. Each loop requires review and re-tuning validation; tuning constants do not transfer numerically.

rules.title: MSG instances require review
rules.description: Every MSG instruction must be re-targeted: message type, path, target data table address and connection handling all change. Message targets cannot be confirmed while the network configuration is unknown.

rules.title: IIM instances require manual rewrite
rules.description: Immediate I/O instructions have no equivalent in the target platform's I/O model. Each occurrence requires a manual redesign of the scan-synchronous behaviour it was written to obtain.

rules.title: Indirect addressing mixed handling
rules.description: Indirect data-file references depend on the SLC flat data model. Under a tag-based target each occurrence resolves differently - some become array indexing, some require restructuring. Handling is mixed and must be decided per occurrence.

rules.title: Status file architectural review
rules.description: S: file references depend on SLC processor internals with no one-to-one target equivalent. Each reference requires an architectural decision, not a translation.

rules.title: STI to periodic-task migration review
rules.description: The selectable timed interrupt becomes a periodic task. Execution timing, task priority, overlap handling and interaction with the continuous task change and require timing validation on the target.

rules.title: HMI project unknown
rules.description: No HMI project file was supplied. Screen count, tag references, alarm configuration, communication configuration and scripting cannot be established. No HMI migration effort may be estimated from the available evidence.

unknown.missing_information: HMI application: screens, tags, alarms, communications, scripts
unknown.commercial_impact: HMI scope cannot be priced; exclude or carry an allowance
unknown.technical_impact: PLC tag interface to the HMI cannot be reconstructed
unknown.recommended_resolution: Obtain the HMI project file or upload from the terminal

rules.title: Drive configurations unknown
rules.description: No drive parameter backups were supplied. Drive family, firmware, network configuration and parameter set cannot be established, and drive-related migration effort cannot be quantified.

unknown.missing_information: VFD parameter backups and drive network configuration
unknown.commercial_impact: Drive migration effort cannot be quantified; exclude or carry an allowance
unknown.technical_impact: Drive control interface and parameter reconstruction not possible
unknown.recommended_resolution: Obtain drive backups or perform an onsite parameter upload

rules.title: Drawings stale/incomplete
rules.description: The supplied electrical drawings are not as-built. Field changes since the drawing revision are not documented, so panel and field-wiring scope derived from them carries error.

unknown.missing_information: As-built electrical documentation reflecting field changes
unknown.commercial_impact: Panel and field wiring scope carries unquantified error
unknown.technical_impact: I/O to field device correspondence cannot be fully trusted

rules.title: Safety evidence incomplete
rules.description: The supplied evidence does not establish the machine safety architecture. The absence of a safety controller in the supplied files does NOT establish that safety is outside the scope of this migration - only that it is insufficiently evidenced.

evidence.locator: no safety architecture documentation in manifest

unknown.missing_information: Safety architecture: devices, circuits, performance level, PLC involvement
unknown.commercial_impact: Safety scope cannot be included or excluded responsibly without review
unknown.technical_impact: Interaction between the migrated controller and the safety system is unknown
unknown.recommended_resolution: Safety walkdown and review of the existing safety circuit documentation
